name: OWASP MCP Top 10
description: The first OWASP Top 10 dedicated to a single protocol surface, covering risks specific to MCP-enabled systems: model misbinding, context spoofing, prompt-state manipulation, insecure memory references, and covert channel abuse. Currently in Phase 3 beta and pilot testing, meaning the ten categories are stable enough to cite even though specific rankings and descriptions may still shift before a 1.0 release.
